data.name: Cult Ambush
data.summary: With GSC as Army Faction, start with 6/10/14 Resurgence points for Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught. When a unit is destroyed, if every non-CHARACTER model has Cult Ambush, pay its table cost based on Starting Strength excluding attached Characters: Aberrants 5/10 cost 4/8; either Acolyte type or Metamorphs 5/10 cost 2/4; Jackals 5/10 cost 2/6; Neophytes 10/20 cost 3/6; Purestrains 5/10 cost 2/6. Do not invent costs for unlisted starting sizes. Add an identical full-strength replacement without Characters, with full wounds and refreshed One Shot weapons, in Cult Ambush. Place a 32mm marker more than 8″ horizontally from enemies, or no marker if impossible. Cult Ambush is Strategic Reserves: no Rapid Ingress; later ordinary Strategic Reserves arrival is allowed; no automatic round-three destruction. A non-AIRCRAFT enemy ending any move within 8″ removes a marker unless rescued. At the end of the opponent’s next Movement phase, each remaining marker may bring in one Cult Ambush unit, including in round 1: at least one model touches the marker, all others wholly within 3″, then remove that used marker. Enemy reserve-denial restrictions still apply. Unused markers remain even when no units await arrival.
conditions: Imported source: confirm current wording, timing, targets and restrictions before using this rule.
Source-bound Genestealer Cults study audit; all triggers, target restrictions and usage limits still apply.

data.name: Voice of Command
data.summary: Only an ASTRA MILITARUM Army Faction enables Voice of Command. Each OFFICER’s datasheet sets its battle-round Order allowance and recipients. Issue in your Command phase, or at a phase’s end if that issuing Officer disembarked or was set up in that phase; select one eligible friendly unit within 6″, unless a specific rule changes range. It lasts until your next Command phase starts. A later Order replaces the current one unless a concurrency exception applies. Battle-shocked units cannot receive Orders, and becoming Battle-shocked ends existing Orders unless explicitly excepted. Only ASTRA MILITARUM models benefit. Choices: Move! Move! Move! +3″ Move; Fix Bayonets improve melee WS by 1; Take Aim improve ranged BS by 1; First Rank, Fire! Second Rank, Fire! +1 Attack for Rapid Fire weapons; Take Cover improve Save by 1, no better than 3+; Duty and Honour improve Leadership by 1 and add 1 OC.
